summary: Your acupuncture visit on May 28, 2026 was denied as not covered under your plan. You owe the full $240 charged for this service. However, you have the right to appeal this decision—either through your plan's internal review process or, if denied again, through an external review. Read your plan documents to understand exactly which services are and aren't covered.

lines.explanation: Acupuncture (CPT 97810) is not a covered benefit under your Sunrise Health PPO plan [CODE-PR-204: 'Service not covered by this plan']. The plan paid $0, and you are responsible for the full $240 allowed amount. Remark code N130 directs you to check your plan's benefit documents for details on what services are and are not covered [CODE-N130]. This is not a bill from the provider—it is what the plan determined you may owe if the provider bills you. Before you pay anything, verify the provider's bill against this EOB. You have the right to appeal this denial.

citations.quote: PR-204 means this service is not a covered benefit under your plan, so the full allowed amount is your responsibility. You have the right to appeal if you believe the service should be covered, starting with an internal appeal.
Remark code N130 directs you to review your plan's benefit documents for the rules that apply to this service.

actions: Review your Sunrise Health PPO plan documents (or log into your member portal) to confirm that acupuncture is excluded from coverage. Note the exact exclusion language.

Decide whether you believe acupuncture should be covered under your plan—for example, if your doctor prescribed it for a specific condition. If yes, file an internal appeal with your plan within 180 days of this EOB. Include your doctor's recommendation and clinical reason.

If your internal appeal is denied or if the plan does not respond within 30 days, you may request an external review by an independent third party. Ask your plan for the external review process and forms.
Do not pay Meridian Wellness Clinic's bill until you have decided whether to appeal. If you receive a bill, keep it and reference this EOB when you contact the clinic or your plan.
